summary: Exercise shared NFS repository ownership and publication primitives in a disposable recovery lab

guide.reason: Contributor feasibility experiment only; no operator recovery workflow is implemented.

api.reason: The experiment directly exercises native NFS filesystem primitives in selected disposable guests; no Controller/Core or client-facing contract changes.

roadmap.reason: S0 and both recovery phases remain open; no product capability becomes available.

state.reason: Only disposable fixture files and test evidence are written; no product state or ownership schema is introduced.

verification.method: Executed the native experiment three times across two selected Debian Core guests and their NFSv4.2 mount aliases; all exited zero. The QA report records exact assertions, tested script and package hashes, and untested crash/fencing/recovery boundaries. Independent review requested exact mount version/source evidence and retained scratch locations; both were added and the final native run passed. A second independent worker verified the corrected script, final private result and matching public script digest with no material findings.
